name: Fiji Citizenship by Registration, Descent (born abroad to a Fiji-citizen parent)

qualifying_event.description: A child born outside Fiji on or after 10 April 2009 to at least one Fiji-citizen parent may register as a Fiji citizen. A two-stage process: registration, then passport issuance.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's proof of Fiji citizenship.

requirements.blocker_text: Born outside Fiji on or after 10 April 2009 to at least one Fiji-citizen parent.

sources.title: Fiji High Commission, New Zealand -- Fiji Citizenship: registration by descent for children born abroad on/after 10 April 2009 to a Fiji-citizen parent, two-stage process (registration then passport), fee NZD 281 (via NZ mission, likely varies by mission currency), 4-6 month minimum timeline; adopted children under 18 of Fiji citizens and minor children of naturalised citizens also qualify

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Fiji). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 sourced via a Fiji diplomatic mission page. NOT TO BE CONFUSED WITH fj_ancestry_exemption.json: this file is an actual CITIZENSHIP grant for children born abroad to a CURRENTLY Fijian parent (one generation, no gap), while the exemption-by-descent route is a non-citizenship immigration exemption reaching three generations back to a person who was a citizen at 1970 Independence, for a population whose direct ancestral link to citizenship was broken. This file also covers adopted children under 18 of Fiji citizens and minor children of naturalised citizens, disclosed rather than split into further files given thin distinguishing detail beyond the core parent-child link. GAP: no explicit generational cap was found for THIS registration route beyond the direct parent-child relationship -- if a Fiji-citizen-by-descent parent's own child born abroad would also qualify indefinitely down the generations, or whether it resets, was not addressed in the 2026 Amendment Act text reviewed; flagged as unresolved rather than assumed unlimited.
